items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: Ralf Kemper, the producer, took it upon himself to finance the whole “Developing Story” and the Dave Brubeck album... Ralf Kemper called the conductor of the Aachen, Germany symphony orchestra... so in February I got my fly miles and flew over there and they performed this.

ctx.x: Yeah. Okay. I’m wondering if you have moments of, I’d guess I’d call reflection. I was watching you in Abbey Road Studios with this forest of fantastic musicians and you’re conducting. Do you ever have a moment afterwards where you go, “God I’m glad I got on that boat.”

Oh yeah. Every day. Every day. Yeah. So yeah I still have to scratch myself for a few things like that, that’s how Ralf Kemper, the producer, took it upon himself to finance the whole “Developing Story” and the Dave Brubeck album. Amazing fellow.
